subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` become a supported hook-level config key for LLM slug generation in this PR?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but repository policy treats config/default/provider routing changes as compatibility-sensitive and this key was previously only schema-passthrough, not a documented contract.

options.title: Accept the hook model contract
options.body: Land this PR as the supported implementation for hook-level slug model routing once normal merge gates pass.

options.title: Require public docs or release-note guardrails
options.body: Ask for explicit public docs or release-note wording before merge so the newly active config key is visible on upgrade.

options.title: Defer to broader slug-model policy
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want dedicated slug-model configuration handled by a broader product decision instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the hook model contract
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the supported implementation for hook-level slug model routing once normal merge gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged/reviewed adjacent slug-routing fixes and recently touched the session-memory handler area, making him the clearest available routing owner for this product/config decision.
